latin: Qualiter uerum sit quod in Epinomide dicitur, arithmeticam scientiam inter omnes speculatiuas maxime facere ad foelicitatem, intelligi potest per conclusiones nostras de mathematicis.
translation: In what way it is true, what is said in the Epinomis, that of all the speculative sciences arithmetic contributes most to happiness, can be understood through our conclusions on mathematics.
